title: Heat Pump vs. Air Conditioner: Full Comparison and Breakdown
summary: An Oklahoma HVAC company explains that a heat pump is an air conditioner that also heats, and the 25C credits ($2,000 heat pump, $600 AC) ending December 2025.

assertions.quote: A heat pump can heat your home and is a viable option as a primary heat source.
So a heat pump has the exact same function except it can do it both ways.
Now, on the heat pump side has a 25c tax credit maximum of $2,000.
So, air conditioner has a maximum 25c tax credit of $600.

verdicts.note: The 25C credit allowed up to $600 for qualifying central air conditioners for 2023-2025 installs.
IRS 25C page: central air conditioners meeting the CEE highest non-advanced tier qualify as residential energy property for a credit of up to $600 per item.
